title: Appointments to the East Maui water board
summary: On August 4, the committee heard from a farmer applying for a council-appointed seat on an East Maui board, and a resolution approving him is to be posted on the August 12 council meeting agenda. He cited 40 years in agriculture and said people should come first in water decisions. In February, the committee voted six to two to recommend approving a separate appointment, the Hawaiian Homes Commission's representative to the East Maui Regional Community Board.
